overview.mechanism: Combines cyclooxygenase inhibition by dexketoprofen with central analgesic actions of tramadol.
uses: Short-term acute-pain treatment studied in postoperative and acute low-back-pain settings; follow the exact combination insert.

paragraphs.text: A randomized hip-arthroplasty trial found greater analgesia with the combination than its individual components. Such efficacy findings do not establish safety in advanced CKD.
The DANTE acute low-back-pain trial did not meet its primary endpoint, although secondary pain outcomes favored the combination in some comparisons. It should not be summarized as uniformly positive.

sources.citation: Randomized clinical trial of dexketoprofen/tramadol in moderate-to-severe pain after total hip arthroplasty. PubMed PMID: 26787797.
Varrassi et al. Dexketoprofen Trometamol and Tramadol Hydrochloride Fixed-Dose Combination in Moderate to Severe Acute Low Back Pain: DANTE. Pain Ther. 2024;13:1007–1022. PubMed PMID: 38922520.
